originalTitle: Mister Organ is one of the most unsettling documentaries I’ve ever seen
summary: Mister Organ doesn't reach the level of societal horror of The Act of Killing or the creepypasta-meets-true-crime gruesomeness of Beware the Slenderman, but there's something deeply unsettling about Michael Organ and his intimate campaign of terror against everyone who enters his life. content: Mister Organ doesn’t reach the level of societal horror of The Act of Killing or the creepypasta-meets-true-crime gruesomeness of Beware the Slenderman, but there’s something deeply unsettling about Michael Organ and his intimate campaign of terror against everyone who enters his life. Mister Organ is a documentary by David Farrier, an Auckland, New Zealand journalist. The movie starts with Farrier reporting on Bashford Antiques, a shop in Ponsonby that has begun aggressively clamping cars in its lot and demanding exorbitant fees to release them — up to $760. Farrier’s article for The Spinoff eventually led the government to introduce legislation that would outlaw extreme clamping fees. Under normal circumstances, that would be the end of the story. But at the center of this story is a man named Michael Organ who turns out to be a bizarre, seemingly dangerous conman. [Media: https://youtu.be/0woo8y3GGZk] Organ was hired to police Bashford’s lot, and during his investigation, Farrier discovers he’s more than just a parking-lot bully. Years earlier, Organ had been charged with attempting to steal a yacht in an elaborate scheme. What’s more, he claimed to be a prince and a lawyer — he is neither. As Farrier talks to people who have known Organ and interacts with him directly, what emerges is a portrait of a deeply troubled man who has left a trail of traumatized people in his wake. The movie shifts from a wild portrait of a conman to something more alarming and tense when Organ reveals he’s gotten his hands on a key to Farrier’s home and only warns him to be careful. From there it spirals even further; eventually, Farrier felt it necessary to leave the country to protect himself from Organ’s campaign of harassment and gaslighting. It’s the rare documentary that doubles as a psychological horror film. Mister Organ is available to stream on Hoopla, Kanopy, and YouTube.
chineseTitle: 《风琴先生》是我看过的最令人不安的纪录片之一
chineseSummary: 《奥根先生》没有达到《杀戮行为》的社会恐怖程度，也没有达到《当心苗条人》那种令人毛骨悚然的面食与真实犯罪的可怕程度，但迈克尔·奥根和他对进入他生活的每个人的亲密恐怖活动却令人深感不安。 《风琴先生》是新西兰奥克兰记者大卫·法里尔 (David Farrier) 拍摄的一部纪录片。 […]
chineseContent: 《奥根先生》没有达到《杀戮行为》的社会恐怖程度，也没有达到《当心细长人》那种令人毛骨悚然的面食与真实犯罪的可怕程度，但迈克尔·奥根和他对进入他生活的每个人的亲密恐怖活动却令人深感不安。 《风琴先生》是新西兰奥克兰记者大卫·法里尔 (David Farrier) 拍摄的一部纪录片。电影一开始，Farrier 报道了庞森比 (Ponsonby) 的一家巴什福德古董店 (Bashford Antiques)，该店开始大肆封锁停车场，并收取高昂的放车费——高达 760 美元。法里尔在《The Spinoff》上发表的文章最终促使政府出台立法，禁止极端的钳制费。正常情况下，故事到此就结束了。但这个故事的中心人物是一个名叫迈克尔·奥根（Michael Organ）的人，他原来是一个奇怪的、看似危险的骗子。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/0woo8y3GGZk] 奥根受雇负责巴什福德停车场的警察，在调查过程中，法瑞尔发现他不仅仅是一个停车场恶霸。几年前，奥根被指控企图通过精心策划的计划偷窃一艘游艇。更重要的是，他声称自己是王子和律师，但他两者都不是。当法里尔与认识器官的人交谈并直接与他互动时，出现的是一幅深受困扰的人的肖像，他的身后留下了一系列遭受创伤的人。当奥根透露他拿到了法瑞尔家的钥匙并只是警告他要小心时，电影从一个骗子的狂野肖像转变为更加令人震惊和紧张的事情。从那里开始，它会进一步螺旋式上升；最终，法里尔觉得有必要离开这个国家，以保护自己免受奥根的骚扰和煤气灯操纵。这是一部罕见的纪录片
